facts.title: Silk – Interactive Generative Art
facts.description: Create beautiful flowing art with Silk.

research.name: Silk
research.note: Browser toy where dragging the pointer paints glowing, flowing silk strands with mirror and rotational symmetry and ambient sound.

effects: Pointer-drawn luminous silk strands mirrored with rotational symmetry and spiral options

unverified: No dated change was found on the site; it shows an undated note that the author is working on a new Silk, so lastUpdated is left empty.
No official source repository was found; GitHub repositories named weavesilk are third-party forks or ports.
